xtmux-5hv.description: Next increment after PR #103 (v0.1). Data substrate already supports it: agent_turns is append-only per (instance_id, turn_index) with completed_at_ms; store.mjs query already orders (completed_at_ms DESC, id DESC). Proposed shape: (1) xtmux-view --list <target> -> newest N turns (index, local time, first line); (2) xtmux-view --turn <idx|N> <target> -> render a specific turn (same render path); (3) optional --cycle: popup runs a persistent loop that re-renders next/prev turn on n/p keys (requires a tiny key reader in the popup command; glow has no content-switch binding, glow dir-mode file browser is the lazy alternative). Caveats: stale/empty last_message_text (see xtmux-9yo race) -> fall back to summary or skip; duplicate rows from repeated Stop captures; ties on completed_at_ms broken by id DESC. No schema change needed.
